aiko-neostar-3p54-485w.summary: The Neostar 3P54 is AIKO's 54-format mono-glass module with n-type ABC (all back contact) cells, published in 5 W bins from 470 W to 500 W. The 485 W bin (AIKO-A485-MCE54Mw) reaches 24.3 percent module efficiency on a 1762 x 1134 x 30 mm frame weighing 21.1 kg, and it is the panel Free State AG installs in 11 of its 12 packages. AIKO states a first-year degradation of at most 1 percent and at most 0.35 percent per year from year 2 to year 30, which leaves 88.85 percent of nameplate power after 30 years.

aiko-neostar-3p54-500w.summary: The 500 W bin of AIKO's Neostar 3P54 mono-glass series (AIKO-A500-MCE54Mw) is the top bin of the same module family as our 485 W panel, reaching 25.0 percent module efficiency. Frame, glass, dimensions, weight, loads, temperature coefficients and warranty terms are identical to the 485 W bin, only the electrical values change. huawei-emma-a02.summary: The EMMA-A02 (Energy Management Assistant) is a DIN rail controller that schedules a home PV system. It measures the grid connection point with a built-in Class 1 measurement module, talks to the inverters over RS485 and to the router over Ethernet or WLAN, and from there controls the LUNA2000 battery, a Huawei wallbox, an SG Ready heat pump over its dry contacts, and smart switches. It is in every Huawei package we sell, and it is the device that schedules whether PV output goes to the house, the battery, the car or the grid. Huawei states that its measurement data cannot be used as the basis for electricity billing, which remains with the utility meter.

sigenergy-sigen-energy-gateway-homemax-t.summary: The Sigen Energy Gateway HomeMax TP is the wall-mounted switching and measuring box that sits between the grid, the SigenStor and the house. Sigenergy describes its function as data acquisition and monitoring, off-grid backup power switching, diesel generator control and energy management, and states it must be used together with a SigenStor BAT and an inverter. It has six wiring ports: grid, backup home loads, a smart port for controllable loads or a generator, two inverter inputs and a communication port, and it carries the miniature circuit breakers and the surge protection device for each of those circuits. It is rated for 380/400 V three-phase at 76 A, and with a Sigen Energy Controller and a battery behind it the stated load-side disruption time on a grid outage is 0 ms.

sigenergy-sigen-evac-11.summary: The Sigen EVAC 11 is an 11 kW three-phase AC wallbox, 6 to 16 A per phase on a 380 to 415 V connection. It comes either with an attached Type 2 cable or with a Type 2 socket with shutter. Authentication is by RFID card, by the mySigen app or automatic with no authentication, and it speaks OCPP 1.6J ED 2 over 4G, WLAN or Ethernet. Together with a SigenStor it charges from PV surplus with a settable battery boost priority and battery cut-off state of charge, and with a Sigen Power Sensor it does dynamic load management so the house connection is not overloaded. The enclosure is rated IP65 and IK10, the integrated fault detection covers AC 30 mA and DC 6 mA, and Sigenergy gives 3 years of warranty in Europe.

sigenergy-sigenstor-ec-20-0-tp.summary: The SigenStor EC 20.0 TP is the Sigen Energy Controller of a SigenStor stack, a three-phase hybrid unit that combines the PV inverter, the battery DC/DC stage and the system controller in one housing. It takes up to 32.0 kW of PV on 4 MPP trackers and feeds 20 kW of rated AC power into a 380/400 V three-phase connection. One to six SigenStor BAT modules stack underneath it, and with a Sigen Energy Gateway and at least one battery the system carries backup loads with a stated load-side disruption time of 0 ms. In our packages it is paired with two SigenStor BAT 8.0 modules in SOLARABO_L (8.06 kWh nominal and 7.8 kWh usable each) and two SigenStor BAT 10.0 modules in SOLARABO_XL (9.04 kWh nominal and 8.76 kWh usable each).

sofar-dtsu666.summary: The DTSU666 is the three-phase DIN rail energy meter that sits at the house connection point in every SolarFree package. It measures import and export on all three phases and sends the reading to the SOFAR HYD hybrid inverter over RS485, which is what lets the system prioritise self-consumption, hold a feed-in limit and cap the power drawn from the grid. The meter is built by Zhejiang Chint Instrument and Meter and sold under the SOFAR name. It exists in two versions, one wired directly into the supply up to 80 A and one that measures through 200 A / 5 A current transformers for larger connections.

sofar-ev11k-ac-02.summary: The EV11k-AC-02 is the 11 kW three-phase wallbox offered with every SolarFree package, alongside the SOFAR HYD hybrid inverter and AIKO Neostar 3P54 panels. It has a fixed 7 m Type 2 cable, starts on an RFID card or from the inverter display and the SOFAR Cloud app, and supports OCPP 1.6 JSON. In ECO mode the HYD inverter steers the charging current from the solar surplus, beginning single-phase at 6 A and moving to three-phase once the surplus passes 4.2 kW. Residual current protection is type A with an added 6 mA DC detection, so no separate type B RCD is needed.

sofar-hyd-10ktl-3ph.summary: The SOFAR HYD 10 kW is the three-phase hybrid inverter in the SolarFree M package, where it works with AIKO Neostar 3P54 panels. It combines the PV inverter, the battery charger and a backup output in one wall-mounted unit, running two MPP trackers on the DC side and two battery inputs of 180 to 800 V DC that charge and discharge at up to 10 kW. During a grid outage it transfers the backup output within 10 ms (default setting) and can supply an unbalanced three-phase load. It is certified to EN 50549-1:2019 for grid-parallel operation.
